name: an_abandoned_mine_with_rubble_rail_track
description: A forgotten mine gallery: rails and ore carts on a gravel bed, rubble from a cave-in, a slick seep, a fenced-off open shaft and a caged lift behind a rusty portcullis.
theme: an abandoned mine with rubble, rail tracks, a lift cage gate and ore carts

zones.name: dock
zones.label: the green mark on the loading dock

zones.name: cart_bay
zones.label: the orange cart bay at the end of the rails

zones.name: tool_corner
zones.label: the blue mark in the tool corner

zones.name: winch_spot
zones.label: the purple mark by the winch

tasks.name: ride_the_lift
tasks.instruction: Step on the brass plate by the lantern post to wind up the rusty cage gate, then walk through and stand inside the lift cage.
paraphrases: Press the brass floor plate to open the cage gate, then go into the lift.
Open the lift with the brass plate near the lantern and step into the cage.

tasks.name: ore_to_bay
tasks.instruction: Shove the dark lump of ore south along the rail line, past the sleepers, into the orange cart bay at the end of the tracks.
paraphrases: Push the ore chunk down the rails to the orange mark.
Roll the dark rock along the track bed into the cart bay.

tasks.name: seep_crossing
tasks.instruction: Cross the glistening wet seep in the south floor — it is slick as ice — and stop on the blue mark in the tool corner.
paraphrases: Get over the slippery wet patch to the tool corner.
Mind the slick seep on your way to the blue mark by the crate.

tasks.name: shaft_watch
tasks.instruction: Go to the purple mark by the winch, but give the open shaft a wide berth — never step into the dark pit.
paraphrases: Stand by the winch near the shaft, keeping well clear of the hole.
Reach the purple winch mark without going anywhere near the pit edge.
